status: evaluation findings reconciled into 104-property research catalog; no hosted SDK baseline
scope_bias_disposition: Whole repository, native, TCG and real hosted coverage are authorized; no scope-narrowing question is needed. Keep environment-specific proof limits.
control_core_limit: Real Control-only hosted runtime reports execution_ready=false with unavailable pool; Marshall admission requires execution_ready=true and fresh measured available ZFS pool. Accepted placement needs prospective integrated real inner-ZFS-backed Lilly host or native KVM. Standalone storage-router is not the backing pool; no fake admission or bypass.
execution_rule: No mutants until a matching real baseline and oracle are green. Current native repairs/runs are scoped local evidence, not hosted Antithesis coverage.

findings.summary: Existential Sometimes cannot prove every eligible operation eventually finishes.
Optional AlwaysOrUnreachable can pass without danger path.
Hosted/TGC/native proof scopes are mixed without a row roster.
Static decoder/version/migration matrices should be ordinary tests; preserve fault transition slice.
High-value intermediate search checkpoints remain prose only.
Terminal kill needs observed blocked PTY write.
Pool sampling progress can pass without contention.
Exact production cap setup may be too large for routine hosted search.
Control version refusal combines permanent and recoverable owner behavior.
Guest identity cutover fixed conversion dominates unless later reuse race is retained.
Browser magic-link/MFA/remembered login and administrative revocation absent.
Physical guest isolation and Brady egress/attribution authority absent.
Clone, resize and relocation byte/GUID/route lineage thin.
Agent tools and normal named integration effects thin.
SSH, DNS route and personal editor effects absent.
Inception and guest/profile/provider variants need explicit selection and possibly properties.
Interrupted isolated restore publication absent.
Lyra updater/enrollment/secret custody and diagnostic-independent user progress absent.
Optional reach, liveness restoration and priority distribution need an exact roster.
Catalog begins after customer browser authority already exists.
Safe handoff does not imply useful copied bytes or new route.
No assertion joins acknowledged create to same-customer usable persistent guest.
Backward clock step may publish complete manifest invalid for later retention.
Historical restore reentry requires policy receipt absent from source.
Every row needs executable history, independent typed oracle, assertion evaluation and unexercised state.
Control requires real authenticated wire and effect histories.
Lease requires causal effect barrier; Galileo anchor remains unsettled.
External effects require faithful local origins and full-cap witnesses.
Physical lifecycle needs real lower boundary and two-host transfer for full claims.
Backup/measurement custody needs actual Restic, SQLite, systemd producer and quota faults.
Guest/workspace/terminal need boot-bound independent effect witnesses.
Updater/migration need native NixOS closure/systemd/migrator evidence.
Control-only hosted pool has identity without measured available ZFS or execution readiness; Marshall refuses accepted placement.

implementation_prerequisites.title: Assertion and oracle lifecycle
implementation_prerequisites.action: Build a 75-ID assertion manifest with literal kind/message/location, typed unavailable/refused/committed observations, append-only independent attempt/effect ledgers outside ANTITHESIS_OUTPUT_DIR, setup_complete owner and explicit unexercised reports.

implementation_prerequisites.title: Source-built images and SDK smoke
implementation_prerequisites.action: Build pinned release/closure OCI images, compile-time harness-only lower seams, Python SDK and BEAM fallback JSONL, Rust symbols/build IDs; run local Compose and small hosted declaration/evaluation smoke before broad runs.

implementation_prerequisites.title: Authenticated Control wire fixture
implementation_prerequisites.action: Use bounded real TLS/WebSocket peer/proxy with reviewed synthetic credentials, exact call/wire IDs, hello/close class and postcommit effect ledger; positive control for each malformed/refusal case.

implementation_prerequisites.title: Lease/effect causal barriers
implementation_prerequisites.action: Record grant/request-start/renewal in one clock domain where possible and use causal guest/upstream first-effect barriers across containers; never treat socket close/timer/log as absence of bytes.

implementation_prerequisites.title: Faithful external origins
implementation_prerequisites.action: Build separate real provider/integration/Git origin logs and Brady TPROXY route with fixed-source policy, actual Git/native locks and accepted-effect IDs; validate production caps in dedicated measured campaigns.

implementation_prerequisites.title: Physical guest and storage adapters
implementation_prerequisites.action: Boot and measure real TCG guest and separate ZFS/router VM; preserve real Lilly Store/Runtime/actor/journal, QEMU PID/overlay/boot/vsock, ZFS GUID, owned quota and actual pressure freshness. Do not claim Firecracker isolation or production backing from TCG.

implementation_prerequisites.title: Two-host transfer/native acceptance
implementation_prerequisites.action: Use native two-Lilly KVM/ZFS fixture for full relocation/copy/cleanup, physical VMM and network witness; a fake import/stop receipt cannot close these rows.

implementation_prerequisites.title: Restic, telemetry and native updater
implementation_prerequisites.action: Use isolated Restic restores and owned ZFS cleanup, real recorder/SQLite producer identity and quota faults, and native NixOS closure/migrator/systemd/secret/health observations; current fixture passes remain scoped local evidence only.

implementation_prerequisites.title: Integrated real ZFS host for accepted placement
implementation_prerequisites.action: Build and measure a real inner-ZFS-backed Lilly host that reports execution_ready only when actual execution and current measured pool are available, then wire its session/report to Marshall. Use this for accepted placement and guest/satellite effects. Keep standalone storage-router separate; control-only host must report unavailable and cannot be used as fake admission.

genuine_policy_questions.title: Historical restore activation policy
genuine_policy_questions.question: What operator-controlled receipt establishes safe transition from quarantined restored DB/disk/host state to serving authority, if such activation is supported?
genuine_policy_questions.reason: Inspected source/ADRs define isolated restore and document UID/sequence reconciliation limits; no automatic activation command or cross-component RPO was found.
genuine_policy_questions.independent_work: Keep quarantine/partial restore properties and native isolated restore drill; do not promise reentry.

genuine_policy_questions.title: Galileo grant TTL anchor
genuine_policy_questions.question: Is a Galileo grant deadline anchored at Marshall grant response or at later upstream lease creation after synchronous measurement admission?
genuine_policy_questions.reason: Source exposes a 2-second grant and up to 5-second accounting wait before local deadline creation; intended authority semantics are not established by code order alone.
genuine_policy_questions.independent_work: Build original grant/renewal/upstream first-effect ledger and report timing without declaring a violation.

deferred_candidate.reason: No operator activation/reconciliation receipt exists; positive reentry is not an executable property.
